want: a calendar grid of one pay cycle showing what I spent each day
soThat: I can see which days were heavy and open a single day's transactions, instead of scrolling one long list
acceptance: the Calendar tab shows the current pay cycle as a weekday-aligned grid, each in-cycle day cell showing that day's spending total
selecting a day lists that day's transactions

a currency toggle switches the grid and the cycle totals between THB and IDR
days outside the selected pay cycle are shown dimmed and are excluded from the cycle totals
